subject: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Transit Logistics <ops@tlogistics.com>, The Harbor Hall Events <events@theharborhall.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop

Team —

We have the Nova Prospect executive workshop in Seattle on Monday 11/23. Requesting consolidated shipping plan for the field kits, flight cases, and swag so we can execute a single pickup on Monday morning and guarantee delivery to the venue by 10:30am. Key constraints:

- Contents: 6 flight cases (hardware demo boxes), 12 soft roll-cases (cables, mics), 20 medium swag boxes (t-shirts, chargers), and a bundle of printed playbooks (approx 150 copies).
- Fragile items: flight cases contain display panels and 2 Pelican boxes with demo appliances (label "FRAGILE - NV"), need double-layer foam and top-loading orientation noted.
- Delivery window: 08:00–10:30 on 11/23 to loading dock B at The Harbor Hall. Onsite contact: Miguel Rios, +1 206-555-0123.
- Insurance: we require at least $50k declared value coverage and proof of insurance before pickup.

Please reply with: pickup ETA, palletization approach (skid vs loose boxes), estimated transit time, tentative quote, and any pickup lead times you need for crating. Diego/Tessa/Marissa — I need the final packing list and the swag manifest by EOD today to attach to the Bill of Lading. Sergio — looping you for budget ok on expedited handling if needed.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial_contents_csv_stub (see attachments to follow)

From: Transit Logistics <ops@tlogistics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: The Harbor Hall Events <events@theharborhall.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the details. We can do a single pickup from your SF distribution center on Monday 11/23 at 06:30am PT with a dedicated tail-lift truck. Preliminary plan:

- Palletization: 2 Euro pallets for flight cases (stacked, anti-slip between layers), 2 pallets for swag & printed collateral separated and shrink-wrapped, roll-cases loose and strapped to an over-pallet with corner protection.
- Fragile handling: all "FRAGILE - NV" boxes to be top-loaded on both pallets; we recommend extra foam blankets and "DO NOT STACK" placards.
- Transit: SF -> Seattle transit time 12–14 hours via dedicated overnight freight (non-stop). Delivery ETA 08:00–09:30 11/23 to loading dock B.
- Quote: expedited tail-lift pickup + next-day dedicated freight + $65 pallet insurance surcharge = $1,780 (+ applicable fuel surcharge). Formal quote attached as TLOG-QUOTE-77821.

We will need the finalized packing list and declared values by 17:00 PT today to print BOL and arrange insurance. We can provide tracking numbers 2 hours after pickup.

Regards,
Anita Shah
Operations Lead
Transit Logistics
Attachment: TLOG-QUOTE-77821.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Transit Logistics <ops@tlogistics.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop

Grace / Anita —

Packing list (final):
- 6 x Flight cases (labels: FC-01..FC-06) — each case contains: demo hub, touchscreen monitor (10.1"), power brick, spare cables. Declared value per case: $3,500.
- 2 x Pelican boxes (P-01, P-02) — internal sensors & microservers. Declared value each: $4,200 (mark FRAGILE).
- 12 x Soft roll-cases (cables / mics / accessories).
- 20 x Swag boxes (mix of shirts, chargers, stickers) — total declared value $1,800.
- Printed playbooks: 150 copies in one flat box (approx 35 lbs).
- Total declared shipment value: $33,600.

Packaging notes: add foam inserts to P-01/P-02, apply "TOP LOAD ONLY" sticker to pallets with Pelican boxes, and include a master packing sheet in a weatherproof sleeve attached to the top pallet.

Attaching swag_manifest.xlsx and packing_list_v3.pdf (stubs). Please confirm BOL staging and insurance certificate.

Diego
Logistics & Events Operations

Attachments: swag_manifest.xlsx, packing_list_v3.pdf

From: The Harbor Hall Events <events@theharborhall.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Transit Logistics <ops@tlogistics.com>
Cc: Elaine Brooks <elaine.brooks@novaprospect.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop

Hi all —

Confirmed: loading dock B will be open for Redwood freight delivery between 08:00–10:30 on 11/23. Please dispatch label with carrier arrival number 24 hours before arrival so security can pre-stage. Onsite contact is Miguel Rios (dock supervisor) — Miguel will meet truck and escort crates to ballroom A.

Notes from venue: no pallet jacks inside ballroom; we will supply a porter team to move items from dock to inside on rolling carts. If any items require direct placement on stage, please flag them on the master packing sheet.

Regards,
Events Operations
The Harbor Hall

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Field kit pallet plan, fragile handling & swag stowage for Nova Prospect workshop

Thanks everyone —

We are green to proceed. Sergio approved the expedited charge. Transit Logistics: please proceed with the 06:30 pickup and send the BOL and insurance certificate to my inbox plus a copy to events@theharborhall.com. Also send tracking numbers when available; we will post them to the Nova Prospect shared folder and to Elaine.

Checklist for pickup team (final):
- BOL prints (2) + master packing sheet attached to pallet 1.
- Pelican boxes padded and marked TOP LOAD ONLY.
- Swag boxes shrink-wrapped separately and labeled "For Nova Prospect - Exec Workshop".
- Insurance certificate on file (min $50k).
- Onsite contact Miguel Rios, arrival number to be emailed 24 hrs before arrival.

Final attachments included: packing_list_v3.pdf, swag_manifest.xlsx, insurance_certificate.pdf.

Grace
